request.style: English, male tenor solo with ethereal choir, harp, cello, flute, timpani, solemn and reverent, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In view of all this great thing
We enter into a binding agreement
Put in writing with solemn intent
The names are written on the sealed document

[Verse]
Nehemiah the governor stands first
Son of Hacaliah with his own name
Zedekiah Seraiah Azariah
Jeremiah Pashhur Amariah

[Verse]
Malchijah Hattush Shebaniah Malluch
Harim Meremoth Obadiah Daniel
Ginnethon Baruch Meshullam Abijah
Mijamin Maaziah Bilgai and Shemaiah

[Chorus]
On the sealed document our names are found
The Levites stand with their feet on the ground
Binnui of the sons of Henadad
Kadmiel Shebaniah Hodiah

[Verse]
Kelita Pelaiah Hanan Mica
Rehob Hashabiah Zaccur Sherebiah
Shebaniah Hodiah Bani Beninu
These are the Levites who sealed the line

[Chorus]
On the sealed document our names are found
The Levites stand with their feet on the ground
Binnui of the sons of Henadad
Kadmiel Shebaniah Hodiah

[Bridge]
The rest of the people joined their brothers
Bound themselves with a curse and an oath
To walk in the Law of God given
Through Moses the servant of God

[Chorus]
On the sealed document our names are found
The Levites stand with their feet on the ground
To keep and carry out His command
With judgments and statutes of the Lord

[Outro]
Separate from the peoples of the lands
To follow the Law of God in our hands
